properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-29: reflow2 serves no compact read of where a design's SUBJECT stands (its current values); graph_report_markdown (6.3 KB on a 422-node design) says where the DESIGN stands, and the record a budget-limited reader needed was a hand-written Fragment
properties.source: published reflow2-mcp 0.93.1 --call on a copy of the recall pilot's finished store (recall-exp armC, 422 nodes), session 5c7a072b
properties.statement:
Asked while building the first-read cue (increment 2): which read that reflow2 already serves gives a newcomer where the design stands within a few KB? Measured on the recall pilot's finished design (422 nodes, 91 design nodes) with the published 0.93.1 binary: graph_report_markdown 6,288 bytes; graph_report 14,266; open_questions 8,080; loop_status 7,641; what_next 1,442; the where-am-i skill is a 20 KB procedure of a dozen reads. graph_report_markdown is the only compact one, and it reports the DESIGN's standing (node counts, delivered N of M, top gaps, trajectory), not the SUBJECT's: none of these returns the current values the budgeted reader was asked about (array size, pump installed, in service from 21 Oct). Those lived in frag:state-as-of-12-nov-2025, a nameless Fragment the writing agents invented, which search_design "current state" ranks among the first four hits (three older state-as-of fragments rank above the latest). So the first-read cue names graph_report_markdown and then search_design for the design's own current-state record; a reflow2-served "where things stand" read of the subject (latest-wins over dated state records, or a declared current-state record type) is NOT built here and is open. Not established: whether such a read would match the hand-written note (fact:root-cause-a-budget-limited-reader-was-not-cued-to-the-designs-current-state-record-2026-10-29, ⑨).
